scientific_question: Does fold-safe FTV-residual SPH supervision organize the confirmed LOCAL response state toward non-volume morphology and improve complementarity while preserving its FTV and observed-delta-FTV behavior?

terminology.SPH_res: FTV-independent morphological component within the frozen linear residualization convention

population.fold_contract: reuse exact seed-2026 patient folds without refill or movement
population.broader_training_contract: reuse the frozen Stage-B fold-specific JEPA construction, including the fixed external-train-only candidate union
population.endpoint_masking: SPH losses and SPH endpoints are restricted to valid observations in the 375-person complete-case population; patients without SPH remain eligible for the frozen JEPA objective and any separately valid frozen FTV objective

model.pooling: fixed fractional-overlap LOCAL pooling at the C1B-H crop center

sph_target.definition: surface area of an equal-volume sphere divided by the surface area of the three-dimensional FTV tumor mask
sph_target.head: one shared Linear(192,1) head applied independently to response_state_t

loss.name: Huber
loss.mask: same-visit SPH measurement valid and member of the 375-person complete-case estimand

fold_safe_target_transform.fit_scope: each outer-fold training partition only, separately at each visit
fold_safe_target_transform.initial_scaling: separate train mean and population standard deviation for transformed FTV and transformed SPH
fold_safe_target_transform.residual_target_S2: epsilon standardized again by its outer-train mean and population standard deviation
fold_safe_target_transform.application: apply only the train-fitted winsor limits, transforms, scalers, ridge coefficients, and residual scaler to validation and test
fold_safe_target_transform.storage: one public coefficient-and-transform record per fold and visit, without patient-level values
fold_safe_target_transform.reconstruction: combine predicted epsilon with the train-fitted conditional SPH component from observed FTV, then invert the train-fitted SPH scaler/identity transform

S0.label: confirmed_LOCAL3_reference
S0.training: reuse hash-verified confirmed LOCAL3 artifacts; do not silently substitute an unverified workspace file

training.sigreg: one exact nonlinear logical-B32 reduction with its exact surrogate gradient

checkpoint_selection.paired_reference: the hash-verified selected S0 checkpoint for the same seed and fold
checkpoint_selection.eligible_epoch: all monitored quantities finite, representation noncollapsed, and validation state loss <= 1.05 times the paired selected S0 validation state loss
checkpoint_selection.primary_choice: among eligible epochs, minimize validation FTV loss
checkpoint_selection.fallback: if no epoch is eligible, minimize positive state-gate violation, then validation FTV loss, then validation state loss, then earliest epoch; mark the cell failed
checkpoint_selection.rationale: strict compatibility with the confirmed response-state selection rule; SPH is an optimization auxiliary and cannot choose its own checkpoint

representation_probes.feature: selected frozen online pre-projector LOCAL response state [N,4,192]
representation_probes.alpha_selection: minimum validation target-space MSE with smaller-alpha tie break
representation_probes.five_fold_aggregation: pool held-out OOF predictions within each training seed before endpoint metrics

observed_delta_FTV.definition: literal natural FTV_end - FTV_start from response_state_end - response_state_start

pcr_firewall.representation_phase: must not import, read, join, log, select on, or otherwise access pCR or clinical labels
pcr_firewall.freeze_requirement: all checkpoints, target transforms, residualizers, response-state exports, and representation-probe specifications must be immutable and hash-manifested before pCR evaluation

logistic.feature_preprocessing: outer-train StandardScaler and fold-safe categorical encoding
logistic.selection: maximum validation AUROC with smaller-C tie break

paired_comparisons.E1: S2 - S0 static FTV macro Spearman
paired_comparisons.E2: S2 - S0 observed delta FTV macro Spearman
paired_comparisons.E5: S2 - S0 MRI-only pCR AUROC at each frozen timing
paired_comparisons.E6: C+F+M_S2 - C+F, compared with C+F+M_S0 - C+F

A_RESPONSE_SAFETY.delta_systematic_degradation_definition: both seed-level E2 effects are strictly negative
A_RESPONSE_SAFETY.optimization_safety: at least 9 of 10 S2 lambda=0.05 seed-by-fold cells satisfy the registered state-loss rule without fallback

B_RESIDUAL_SPH_ORGANIZATION.minimum_pass: E3 > 0 in each seed and mean(E3) >= 0.05

D_DOWNSTREAM_COMPLEMENTARITY.minimum_pass: at least one same eligible timing has C+F+M_S2 - C+F > 0 in each seed
D_DOWNSTREAM_COMPLEMENTARITY.strong_form: minimum pass holds and the two-seed mean delta AUROC at a qualifying timing is >= 0.03

precedence: if Gate A or Gate B fails: SPH_GROUNDING_NOT_USEFUL
else if Gate C fails: RAW_SPH_SUFFICIENT
classification.five_seed_confirmation_authorized_only_i: Gates A, B, and C pass; Gate D separately determines complementarity support
classification.burden_redundant_rule: if raw SPH improves but SPH_res does not, classify the improvement as burden-redundant

privacy.public_outputs: aggregate metrics, fold-level transform/residualizer coefficients without patient rows, figures, reports, hashes, and decision labels
privacy.private_outputs: patient-level memberships, identifiers, predictions, feature tensors, image paths, checkpoints, and logs containing row-level data
